scientific_integrity: Theorem proved analytically by exhaustive connected tight-graph classification. A separate exact enumeration checks nine finite specializations but does not prove the universal claim. Published tools for tight-graph extremality and polarity are credited, not claimed as discoveries. Bibliographic priority is not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Real finite Lipschitz-free spaces; \(N\ge4\); exactly two incident equal long edges with \(t\in[1,2]\); number of facets only. The endpoint cases rely on a separate exhaustive classification and are included for comparison.
title: Exact facet jumps under two incident distance elongations
